item.tib: snyan rgyud zhi gcod bog 'don dmar thag bcad pa'i rims pa
item.coloph: man ngag zab mos (mo'i) snyan rgyud 'di nyid ni/ tshad med thugs rjes (rje'i) mnga' bdag bla ma la/ mkha' spyod ye shes khams (mkha') 'gros lung bstan nas/ brda' tshigs (brda tshig) sgram zhing dmar la dril ba 'di/ man ngag bcud kyis (kyi) don snying (snyan) du brgyud/ sman gsol shin tu zabs (zab) pa'i dkar (bka') ma sbyin gcig (cig) bka' rgya nan tan byas/ bdag gis (gi) snying khrag gnyen po ma 'phod zer/ skal pa ldan pa'i gang zag 'ga' tsam las/ snod med rnams la bstan na bka' chad 'byung / de ltar bka' rgya gnad dang bcas pa 'di/ las dang skal ba ldan pa'i rnal 'byor la/ dad mos ldan pa'i btsun tshul dar pa bdag gis zhus//
